proposed_widenings.name: transport_exile
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary deterministic effect is moving the user and chosen willing creatures into a safe demiplane. The current surface has local teleportation only and cannot represent transport into an out-of-play space.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The rod then instantly transports you and up to 199 other willing creatures you can see to a demiplane.

proposed_widenings.name: return_on_end
proposed_widenings.justification: The demiplane stay is temporary and ends either when the duration expires or when the wielder uses another Magic action. The current surface cannot represent automatic return to the origin point or nearest unoccupied space when the effect ends.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When the time runs out or you take a Magic action to end the effect, all visitors reappear in the location they occupied when you activated the rod or an unoccupied space nearest that location.

proposed_widenings.name: hourly_hit_die_heal
proposed_widenings.justification: The restorative rider is not a fixed heal and not a standard rest reset. It is a recurring hourly heal amount derived from each visitor's own Hit Die expenditure formula, which the current ongoing trigger and heal amount vocabulary cannot express.
proposed_widenings.evidence: For each hour spent in the demiplane, a visitor regains Hit Points as if it had spent 1 Hit Point Die.

proposed_widenings.name: dynamic_group_duration
proposed_widenings.justification: The stay limit is a timed duration derived from the number of creatures present, not a fixed duration or slot-scaling. The current Duration grammar cannot encode a duration calculated from group size.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Visitors can remain there for up to 200 days divided by the number of creatures present (round down).

notes: No content file was authored. The item's main mechanic is the temporary demiplane transport/return loop; omitting that would produce a misleading trace. Narrative/environment riders such as choosing the demiplane's form, food and water provision, harmless environment, object persistence, and no aging were treated as out of core for this survey.
